create_video_generate_task: create a RunwayML video generation task by transforming an image-to-video request with prompt and model parameters
transform_video_create_response: transform a RunwayML image-to-video API response into an OpenAI-compatible VideoObject with status and output URL
run_video_download: download video content from a RunwayML task output URL after extracting the CloudFront link from the task response
retrieve_video_status: retrieve a RunwayML video generation task status by querying the tasks endpoint with the task ID
map_openai_params_to_runway: map OpenAI-style video creation parameters to RunwayML format including prompt, ratio, and duration conversions
